comment: Blocked runtime-evidence setup for the swallowed gulp_blnd_check true-return branch. The planned route creates cream with a cursed towel, creates an adjacent dust vortex, lets it engulf the hero, then applies a plain towel. C mhitu.c gulpmu()'s AD_BLND arm sets or maintains HBlinded before the next hero command, so apply.c use_towel()'s !Blinded guard skips gulp_blnd_check(); if a blindfold remains worn, mondata.c can_blnd() rejects AT_ENGL instead. This recipe is not matching evidence for the blocked branch.
